title: U.S. House, District 28
what_it_does: Represents Florida's 28th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives; votes on federal laws and spending.
verified_ballot_note: Roster from CBS Miami primary roundup and Florida Politics: Carlos Gimenez (R) and Phil 'Felipe' Ehr (D) were each unopposed in their primaries; Eddy Rojas (NPA) makes it a three-way November race. Sources: https://www.cbsnews.com/miami/live-updates/2026-florida-primary-live-updates-results/ ; https://floridapolitics.com/archives/819963-a-powerful-moral-compass-jamie-raskin-backs-phil-ehr-as-veterans-bike-across-cd-28-for-him/ ; https://ehrforcongress.us/ Florida adopted a new congressional map (passed Apr 29, 2026, signed May 4, 2026) that reworked 21 of 28 districts; county descriptions here reflect post-redistricting reporting where found (https://www.wusf.org/politics-issues/2026-05-06/breakdown-changes-for-florida-new-congressional-map).

candidates.background: Carlos Gimenez, a former Miami fire chief and Miami-Dade County mayor (2011-2020), has represented the 28th District since January 2021 (elected in the old 26th). He was unopposed in the Aug. 18, 2026 Republican primary.

candidates.name: Phil "Felipe" Ehr
candidates.background: Phil 'Felipe' Ehr is a retired U.S. Navy commander who served 26 years, including in roles supporting Cold War-era operations, Desert Storm and Allied Force. He was the 2024 Democratic nominee against Carlos Gimenez and was unopposed in the Aug. 18, 2026 Democratic primary. U.S. Rep. Jamie Raskin endorsed him in September 2026.
candidates.primary_result: Unopposed in Aug 18, 2026 Democratic primary (CBS Miami)
